meta.title: 面试报薪资别只报底薪｜总收入这样算
meta.title_en: Report Your Total Income, Not Just the Base

scenes.context: 讲者用一个底薪9k、总收入30k的求职者案例引入问题。
sentences: 收入每月平均到30k，但底薪只有9k。
His monthly income averages 30k, but his base salary is only 9k.
底薪：base salary
剩下的全部都是项目提成。
The rest is all project commission.
项目提成：project commission
担心直接说30k会吓跑一些面试官。
He worries that saying 30k flat-out might scare off some interviewers.
吓跑面试官：scare off interviewers
paraphrase: 报底薪还是报总收入 → 困惑
Report the base or the total? That's the dilemma.
怕报高 → 吓跑面试官
He fears overshooting will scare them off.
scenes.speak: His monthly income averages 30k, but his base salary is only 9k. The rest is all project commission. He worries that saying 30k flat-out might scare off some interviewers.

scenes.title_cn: 要点一二：收入构成与口径
scenes.title_en: Point One & Two: Composition and Terms
scenes.context: 讲者给出前两个要点：收入不只是月薪，还包括浮动收入；口径要提前讲清。
sentences: 工资不只是每月到手的固定月薪。
Your salary isn't just the fixed monthly pay you take home.
固定月薪：fixed monthly pay
还包括绩效奖金、项目提成、年终奖、各种补贴。
It also includes performance bonuses, project commissions, year-end bonuses, and various allowances.
绩效奖金：performance bonus
税前还是税后、年薪还是月薪，要提前讲清楚。
Clarify up front whether it's pre-tax or post-tax, annual or monthly.
税前税后：pre-tax or post-tax
paraphrase: 浮动收入 → 都要算进总收入
All floating income counts toward your total.
口径不清 → 报价失真
Unclear terms make your number misleading.
scenes.speak: Your salary isn't just the fixed monthly pay you take home. It also includes performance bonuses, project commissions, year-end bonuses, and various allowances. Clarify up front whether it's pre-tax or post-tax, annual or monthly.

scenes.title_en: Point Three: Social Security & Housing Fund
scenes.context: 讲者强调社保公积金按全额和最高比例12%缴纳时，面试一定要主动提。
sentences: 社保公积金按薪资全额、最高比例12%缴纳。
If your social security and housing fund are fully covered at the top 12% rate.
缴纳比例：contribution rate
面试的时候一定要提到这一块。
You must bring this up in the interview.
提到这一块：bring this up
尤其是公积金，真金白银，等同于收入。
Especially the housing fund—it's real money, equal to income.
真金白银：real money
paraphrase: 正规缴纳 → 是真金白银
Fully funded contributions are real money.
别漏报 → 主动说出来
Don't leave it out—bring it up yourself.
scenes.speak: If your social security and housing fund are fully covered at the top 12% rate. You must bring this up in the interview. Especially the housing fund—it's real money, equal to income.

practice: My total income averages about 30k a month.
表达「除了底薪还有提成」
Beyond the base, I earn project commissions.
Just to be clear—is this pre-tax monthly or annual?
表达「公积金按最高比例」
My company contributes to my housing fund at the maximum 12% rate.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：My salary is 12k plus 3k float.
✓ 地道说法：My base is 12k, plus about 3k a month in variable pay.
浮动收入用 variable pay，不是 float。
✓ 地道说法：I'd quote my total income, not just the base.
报薪资用 quote，报的是 total income。
✕ 直译腔：The salary is before tax or after tax?
✓ 地道说法：Is that pre-tax or post-tax?
✕ 直译腔：The housing fund is equal to income.
✓ 地道说法：The housing fund is real money on top of my salary.
等同收入用 on top of my salary 更自然。
shifts: 只报底薪、怕报多吓跑对方
先对齐税前税后、年薪月薪
忽略社保公积金的隐性收入
正规缴纳就主动说出来
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文「技巧奖金」按语境校正为「绩效奖金」，「甄静白银」校正为「真金白银」；案例中的收入数字（底薪9k、总收入30k）以转录为准保留。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
